Room.title: Room
Room.description: Multiplayer game room controlled by a host/teacher for up to 25 students.

hostUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the room host.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the multiplayer session.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the room was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last room state transition.

countdownStartedAt.description: Server timestamp when synchronized 3-2-1-GO countdown began.

startTime.description: Server timestamp when active gameplay began.

endTime.description: Server timestamp when the host ended the game.

challengeSeed.description: Deterministic seed ensuring identical challenge order for all players in the room.

roundNumber.description: Current session round number, incremented when host triggers Play Again.

playerCount.description: Current number of joined students in the room.

Player.title: Player
Player.description: Student participant inside a multiplayer room.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student.

normalizedKey.description: Hex/safe slug key corresponding to the student's unique name lock.

avatarColor.description: Hex color for player avatar badge.

completed.description: Challenges completed in current level (0 to 15).

totalCompleted.description: Total challenges completed across all levels in the round.

status.description: Connection or elimination state of the player.

roundNumber.description: Round number matching the room's current round.

joinedAt.description: Server timestamp when the student joined.

lastSeen.description: Server timestamp of the player's latest heartbeat.

PlayerNameLock.title: PlayerNameLock
PlayerNameLock.description: Atomic uniqueness lock preventing duplicate student names in the same room.

uid.description: UID of the student holding this name lock.

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Top-20-only leaderboard record for a qualifying player in the active room round.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the ranked student.

avatarColor.description: Hex color for player avatar badge.

level.description: Highest level reached by the player.

totalCompleted.description: Total challenges completed across the round.

roundNumber.description: Round number matching the active room session.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest leaderboard update.

LeaderboardMeta.title: LeaderboardMeta
LeaderboardMeta.description: Atomic Top-20 gatekeeper tracking count (max 20), active UIDs, and current rank #20 threshold.

roundNumber.description: Current round number matching the room.

count.description: Exact number of entries in leaderboard (0 to 20).

entryUids.description: Bounded list (max 20) of player UIDs currently stored in leaderboard.

minEntryUid.description: UID of the lowest-ranked player currently in the leaderboard (rank #20 when full).

minScore.description: Score of the lowest-ranked player currently in leaderboard.

minLevel.description: Level of the lowest-ranked player currently in leaderboard.

minTotalCompleted.description: Total completed count of the lowest-ranked player currently in leaderboard.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last leaderboard state update.

SoloLeaderboardEntry.title: SoloLeaderboardEntry
SoloLeaderboardEntry.description: Dedicated leaderboard record for independent Solo mode runs (strictly isolated from Multiplayer).

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the Solo player.

avatarColor.description: Hex color for player avatar badge.

level.description: Highest level reached in the Solo run.

totalCompleted.description: Total challenges completed in the Solo run.

durationSeconds.description: Total duration of the Solo run in seconds.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the Solo run finished.

MultiplayerLeaderboardEntry.title: MultiplayerLeaderboardEntry
MultiplayerLeaderboardEntry.description: Global Multiplayer leaderboard record synced from verified room sessions (strictly isolated from Solo).

roomCode.description: Room code where the score was earned.

roundNumber.description: Round number in the multiplayer room.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player.

avatarColor.description: Hex color for player avatar badge.

score.description: Multiplayer score earned in the room.

level.description: Highest level reached in the room.

totalCompleted.description: Total challenges completed in the room.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest score update.

/rooms/{roomCode}.description: Multiplayer game room state, host metadata, shared seed, and synchronized timers.

/rooms/{roomCode}/players/{playerId}.description: Individual student state, score, lives, level, and connection status inside a room.

/rooms/{roomCode}/names/{nameKey}.description: Uniqueness lock ensuring no two students in the same room share the same name.

/rooms/{roomCode}/leaderboard/{entryId}.description: Top-20-only leaderboard documents for the current room session. Rank 21+ is never stored.

/rooms/{roomCode}/leaderboardMeta/{docId.description: Top-20 gatekeeper document ('state') tracking count <= 20 and lowest-rank eviction threshold.

/soloLeaderboard/{entryId}.description: Dedicated leaderboard storing completed Solo mode scores.

/multiplayerLeaderboard/{entryId}.description: Dedicated global Multiplayer leaderboard synced from verified room scores.
